decisions.reason: A low-maintenance net price display plugin close to the core shop offer adds value to client projects at little cost, so with no performance shortfall there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
The ERP interface plugin builds on the established offer and supports the multichannel strategy, so it likely meets aspirations and ties clients more closely to the firm.
Price comparison tracking plugins support the firm's measurable-marketing promise and are cheap to maintain, so slack lets the firm carry this one despite uncertain demand.
This second price comparison tracking plugin overlaps with the others and could be consolidated, but its maintenance costs are low enough to keep it for another year.
Like the other tracking plugins, it serves a specific comparison portal at minimal cost, so management keeps it unless the portal or demand disappears.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A for B2B shops and fits the established offer, so with no evident shortfall it stays on the market.
